instruments.name: Sub Bass
instruments.description: A deep sine with a gentle lowpass sweep, felt more than heard under the rest of the mix.

instruments.name: Snare
instruments.description: White-noise wires over two short drum tones a bit under an octave apart, 808-style; play it around F#3.

instruments.name: Clap
instruments.description: Three pink-noise bursts that peak a few milliseconds apart, smearing into a hand clap.

instruments.name: Chip Kit
instruments.description: A whole chiptune drum machine in one instrument: kick, snare, clap, hats, toms, crash, and cowbell on the General MIDI drum notes, with the closed hat choking the open one.
